trans-unit.source: Here you can assess and customize the services that we'd like to use on this website. You're in charge! Enable or disable services as you see fit.
trans-unit.target: An seo faodaidh tu na seirbheisean a tha sinn airson a chleachdadh air an làrach-lìn seo a mheasadh agus a ghnàthachadh. Tha an smachd agad fhèin! Cuir seirbheisean an comas no à comas mar a chì thu iomchaidh.

trans-unit.source: Services we would like to use
trans-unit.target: Seirbheisean a tha sinn airson a chleachdadh

trans-unit.source: There were changes since your last visit, please renew your consent.
trans-unit.target: Bha atharrachaidhean ann bhon turas mu dheireadh agad, feuch an ùraich thu do chead.

trans-unit.source: Hi! Could we please enable some additional services for {purposes}? You can always change or withdraw your consent later.
trans-unit.target: Halò! Am faod sinn cuid de sheirbheisean a bharrachd a chur an comas airson {purposes}? Faodaidh tu do chead atharrachadh no a tharraing air ais an-còmhnaidh nas fhaide air adhart.

trans-unit.source: Do you want to load external content supplied by {title}?
trans-unit.target: A bheil thu airson susbaint a-muigh a luchdadh a tha air a thoirt seachad le {title}?

trans-unit.source: To agree to this service permanently, you must accept {title} in the {link}.
trans-unit.target: Gus cead maireannach a thoirt don t-seirbheis seo, feumaidh tu {title} a ghabhail ris ann an {link}.
Air a thoirt gu buil le Klaro!

trans-unit.source: To learn more, please read our {privacyPolicy}.
These services process personal information to show you personalized or interest-based advertisements.
trans-unit.target: Bidh na seirbheisean seo a’ giullachd fiosrachadh pearsanta gus sanasan pearsanaichte no stèidhichte air ùidh a shealltainn dhut.

trans-unit.source: These services are essential for the correct functioning of this website. You cannot disable them here as the service would not work correctly otherwise.
trans-unit.target: Tha na seirbheisean seo riatanach airson obrachadh ceart na làraich-lìn seo. Chan urrainn dhut an cur à comas an seo, oir air dhòigh eile cha bhiodh an t-seirbheis ag obair gu ceart.

trans-unit.source: These services process personal information to show you relevant content about products, services or topics that you might be interested in.
trans-unit.target: Bidh na seirbheisean seo a’ giullachd fiosrachadh pearsanta gus susbaint iomchaidh mu thoraidhean, seirbheisean no cuspairean a dh’fhaodadh ùidh a bhith agad annta a shealltainn dhut.

trans-unit.source: These services process personal information to optimize the service that this website offers.
trans-unit.target: Bidh na seirbheisean seo a’ giullachd fiosrachadh pearsanta gus an t-seirbheis a tha an làrach-lìn seo a’ tabhann a bharrachadh.

trans-unit.source: Use this switch to enable or disable all services.
trans-unit.target: Cleachd an suidse seo gus na seirbheisean uile a chur an comas no à comas.
Cuir na seirbheisean uile an comas no à comas

trans-unit.source: This service is loaded by default (but you can opt out)
trans-unit.target: Thèid an t-seirbheis seo a luchdadh gu bunaiteach (ach faodaidh tu tarraing a-mach)
Tha an t-seirbheis seo riatanach an-còmhnaidh

trans-unit.source: These services gather anonymous data for statistical analysis and performance optimization. Enabling analytics services assists website owners in making informed decisions to enhance online services.
trans-unit.target: Bidh na seirbheisean seo a’ cruinneachadh dàta gun urra airson mion-sgrùdadh staitistigeil agus leasachadh dèanadais. Le bhith a’ cur seirbheisean anailis an comas, cuidichidh e sealbhadairean làraich-lìn gus co-dhùnaidhean fiosraichte a dhèanamh airson seirbheisean air-loidhne a leasachadh.

trans-unit.source: Security services are crucial for safeguarding your online experience. These services help protect your data and privacy by detecting and preventing security threats, such as malware, phishing attempts, and unauthorized access. They ensure a safer browsing environment.
trans-unit.target: Tha seirbheisean tèarainteachd deatamach airson d’ eòlas air-loidhne a dhìon. Cuidichidh na seirbheisean seo le bhith a’ dìon do dhàta agus do phrìobhaideachd le bhith a’ lorg agus a’ casg chunnartan tèarainteachd, leithid bathar-bog droch-rùnach, oidhirpean phishing agus ruigsinneachd gun chead. Bidh iad a’ dèanamh àrainneachd brobhsaidh nas sàbhailte.

trans-unit.source: Live chat services enable real-time communication with website support teams. They offer a convenient way to ask questions, seek assistance, or engage in discussions while browsing a website. Live chat enhances your online interaction and customer support experience.
trans-unit.target: Leigidh seirbheisean cabadaich bheò leat conaltradh ann an àm fìor le sgiobaidhean taice na làraich-lìn. Tha iad a’ tabhann dòigh ghoireasach air ceistean fhaighneachd, cuideachadh iarraidh no còmhraidhean a dhèanamh fhad ’s a tha thu a’ brobhsadh làrach-lìn. Bidh cabadaich bheò a’ leasachadh d’ eadar-obrachadh air-loidhne agus eòlas taic luchd-ceannach.

trans-unit.source: Services related to styling help to improve the appearance of the website. This can also have an impact on usability.
trans-unit.target: Cuidichidh seirbheisean co-cheangailte ri stoidhle le coltas na làraich-lìn a leasachadh. Faodaidh seo buaidh a thoirt air so-chleachdadh cuideachd.

trans-unit.source: Embedding videos from external platforms to enrich the content on this website.
trans-unit.target: A’ leabachadh bhideothan bho àrd-ùrlaran a-muigh gus susbaint na làraich-lìn seo a shaibhreachadh.

trans-unit.source: Embedding social media from external platforms to enrich the content on this website.
trans-unit.target: A’ leabachadh mheadhanan sòisealta bho àrd-ùrlaran a-muigh gus susbaint na làraich-lìn seo a shaibhreachadh.

trans-unit.source: This includes services that do not fall under the other purposes.
trans-unit.target: Tha seo a’ gabhail a-steach seirbheisean nach eil a’ tuiteam fo na h-adhbharan eile.

trans-unit.source: Adobe Fonts provides web fonts used for this website. When enabled, font files are loaded from Adobe and technical connection data may be processed.
trans-unit.target: Tha Adobe Fonts a’ solarachadh fhontan lìn a thathar a’ cleachdadh airson na làraich-lìn seo. Nuair a tha e comasach, thèid faidhlichean font a luchdadh bho Adobe agus faodaidh dàta ceangail teicnigeach a bhith air a ghiullachd.

trans-unit.source: Google AdSense enables personalized ads on websites while respecting user privacy. By consenting, you allow relevant ads and help support free content.
trans-unit.target: Leigidh Google AdSense le sanasan pearsanaichte air làraich-lìn agus e a’ toirt urram do phrìobhaideachd luchd-cleachdaidh. Le bhith a’ toirt cead, leigidh tu le sanasan iomchaidh agus cuidichidh tu le susbaint shaor a chumail suas.

trans-unit.source: Consent to the use of surveillance camera images for security and safety purposes, in compliance with applicable data privacy regulations.
trans-unit.target: Cead airson ìomhaighean camara-faire a chleachdadh airson adhbharan tèarainteachd is sàbhailteachd, a rèir riaghailtean prìobhaideachd dàta iomchaidh.

trans-unit.source: Career Captain provides gamified career orientation and recruiting content. When enabled, external content from Career Captain may process usage and technical connection data.
trans-unit.target: Tha Career Captain a’ toirt seachad susbaint stiùiridh dreuchdail agus fastaidh le eileamaidean geama. Nuair a tha e comasach, faodaidh susbaint a-muigh bho Career Captain dàta cleachdaidh agus dàta ceangail teicnigeach a ghiullachd.

trans-unit.source: Microsoft Clarity is a user-friendly web analytics tool that empowers website visitors like you by providing transparency about how your interactions are tracked on a website. It ensures your privacy is respected while giving developers and website owners valuable insights into user behavior. Plus, it follows coding guidelines and best practices, ensuring a safe and secure online experience for you.
trans-unit.target: Tha Microsoft Clarity na inneal anailis lìn furasta a chleachdadh a bheir follaiseachd do luchd-tadhail làraich-lìn mu mar a thathar a’ tracadh an eadar-obrachadh air làrach-lìn. Bidh e a’ dèanamh cinnteach gu bheil do phrìobhaideachd air a meas, agus aig an aon àm a’ toirt lèirsinn luachmhor do luchd-leasachaidh agus sealbhadairean làraich-lìn mu ghiùlan luchd-cleachdaidh. A bharrachd air sin, bidh e a’ leantainn stiùiridhean còdaidh agus deagh chleachdaidhean, a’ dèanamh eòlas air-loidhne sàbhailte agus tèarainte dhut.

trans-unit.source: Cloudflare helps protect and optimize websites. By using this website, you consent to Cloudflare's data processing practices as described in its Privacy Policy.
trans-unit.target: Cuidichidh Cloudflare le làraich-lìn a dhìon agus a bharrachadh. Le bhith a’ cleachdadh na làraich-lìn seo, tha thu ag aontachadh ri cleachdaidhean giullachd dàta Cloudflare mar a tha iad air am mìneachadh sa phoileasaidh prìobhaideachd aige.

trans-unit.source: Simplifies web tracking for analytics and marketing while ensuring data compliance and control.
trans-unit.target: Nì e tracadh lìn nas sìmplidhe airson anailis agus margaidheachd agus e a’ dèanamh cinnteach à gèilleadh agus smachd dàta.

trans-unit.source: Fast Fonts, operated by fonts.com and supplied by fast.fonts.net, is a service for the provision of web fonts. It requires the use of a pixel-code for continuous price calculation.
trans-unit.target: Tha Fast Fonts, air a ruith le fonts.com agus air a sholarachadh le fast.fonts.net, na sheirbheis airson fontan lìn a thoirt seachad. Feumaidh e còd piogsail a chleachdadh airson àireamhachadh prìse leantainneach.

trans-unit.source: Google Ads allows advertisers to reach their target audience online. To personalize ads and measure their effectiveness, Google may collect data with your consent.
trans-unit.target: Leigidh Google Ads le luchd-sanasachd an luchd-èisteachd targaid aca a ruigsinn air-loidhne. Gus sanasan a phearsanachadh agus an èifeachdas a thomhas, faodaidh Google dàta a chruinneachadh le do chead.

trans-unit.source: Web analytics service provided by Google, Inc. ("Google")
trans-unit.target: Seirbheis anailis lìn air a toirt seachad le Google, Inc. ("Google")
Fontan lìn air an aoigheachd le Google

trans-unit.source: Google Maps allows for the integration of interactive maps on websites, enabling location-based services. Developers can utilize it while ensuring data compliance and control, adhering to coding guidelines and best practices.
trans-unit.target: Leigidh Google Maps le mapaichean eadar-ghnìomhach a bhith air an amalachadh ann an làraich-lìn, a’ comasachadh seirbheisean stèidhichte air àite. Faodaidh luchd-leasachaidh a chleachdadh fhad ’s a tha iad a’ dèanamh cinnteach à gèilleadh agus smachd dàta agus a’ leantainn stiùiridhean còdaidh agus deagh chleachdaidhean.

trans-unit.source: Google Tag Manager streamlines web tracking and code management, ensuring data compliance and control for developers.
trans-unit.target: Bidh Google Tag Manager a’ sgioblachadh tracadh lìn agus stiùireadh còd, a’ dèanamh cinnteach à gèilleadh agus smachd dàta do luchd-leasachaidh.

trans-unit.source: Allows Instagram posts to be embedded. Personal data may be transferred to Instagram (Meta Platforms) in the process.
trans-unit.target: Leigidh e le puist Instagram a bhith air an leabachadh. Faodar dàta pearsanta a ghluasad gu Instagram (Meta Platforms) sa phròiseas.

trans-unit.source: Chat widget and collecting of visitor statistics
trans-unit.target: Widget cabadaich agus cruinneachadh staitistig luchd-tadhail

trans-unit.source: Klaro! manages consent choices for this website and stores whether individual services may be loaded according to your preferences.
trans-unit.target: Bidh Klaro! a’ riaghladh roghainnean cead airson na làraich-lìn seo agus a’ stòradh am faodar seirbheisean fa leth a luchdadh a rèir do roghainnean.

trans-unit.source: Open source software for statistical analysis of visitor accesses
trans-unit.target: Bathar-bog stòr fosgailte airson mion-sgrùdadh staitistigeil air ruigsinneachdan luchd-tadhail

trans-unit.source: Real-time user analytics service that helps to understand how visitors interact with our website.
trans-unit.target: Seirbheis anailis luchd-cleachdaidh ann an àm fìor a chuidicheas le tuigsinn mar a bhios luchd-tadhail ag eadar-obrachadh leis an làrach-lìn againn.

trans-unit.source: SalesViewer analyzes website visits for B2B lead generation and may identify company-related visitor information based on usage and technical access data.
trans-unit.target: Bidh SalesViewer a’ sgrùdadh tadhalan làraich-lìn airson gineadh stiùiridhean B2B agus faodaidh e fiosrachadh luchd-tadhail co-cheangailte ri companaidh aithneachadh stèidhichte air dàta cleachdaidh agus ruigsinneachd teicnigeach.

trans-unit.source: Allows TikTok videos to be embedded. Personal data may be transferred to TikTok and processed in third countries.
trans-unit.target: Leigidh e le bhideothan TikTok a bhith air an leabachadh. Faodar dàta pearsanta a ghluasad gu TikTok agus a ghiullachd ann an treas dùthchannan.

trans-unit.source: X (formerly Twitter) is a social media platform that allows users to share and interact with short messages and multimedia content. Developers can integrate Twitter features into websites to enhance user engagement and real-time updates while maintaining data privacy compliance and adhering to coding guidelines.
trans-unit.target: Tha X (Twitter roimhe) na àrd-ùrlar mheadhanan sòisealta a leigeas le luchd-cleachdaidh teachdaireachdan goirid agus susbaint ioma-mheadhanach a cho-roinn agus eadar-obrachadh leotha. Faodaidh luchd-leasachaidh feartan Twitter amalachadh ann an làraich-lìn gus com-pàirteachadh luchd-cleachdaidh agus ùrachaidhean ann an àm fìor a leasachadh, fhad ’s a tha iad a’ cumail ri gèilleadh prìobhaideachd dàta agus stiùiridhean còdaidh.

trans-unit.source: Userlike offers a live chat solution that enhances user interactions on websites.
trans-unit.target: Tha Userlike a’ tabhann fuasgladh cabadaich bheò a leasaicheas eadar-obrachadh luchd-cleachdaidh air làraich-lìn.

trans-unit.source: Popular video-sharing platform that offers a range of features for creators and developers to enhance video content on websites.
trans-unit.target: Àrd-ùrlar mòr-chòrdte airson bhideothan a cho-roinn a tha a’ tabhann raon de fheartan do luchd-cruthachaidh agus luchd-leasachaidh gus susbaint bhidio a leasachadh air làraich-lìn.

trans-unit.source: The leading video-sharing platform for content creators and developers to enhance user experiences on websites.
trans-unit.target: Am prìomh àrd-ùrlar roinneadh bhideothan do luchd-cruthachaidh susbaint agus luchd-leasachaidh gus eòlasan luchd-cleachdaidh a leasachadh air làraich-lìn.
